notes.gpuProbe: At frame interval boundaries, the probe checks linked light programs until it has measured at least four pairs and found an enabled pair, or exhausted the list. The native UI checkbox check scans all linked programs outside the measured routes.
notes.duration: 3s native fixed views; 10s each at the six town/detail cameras; 3s each in the two walking modes.
notes.fps: 1000 * count / sum(ms), RAF frame submission intervals on the RTX 3060 Laptop, 1440x900, DPR 1
notes.p95: nearest rank; nativeReportP95 records the pre-existing source convention for each segment
notes.originalData: Recreate original segment bytes with the included verify.cjs. The six town files use 2-space JSON plus LF; all four street/walk files use compact JSON.
notes.runs: Native preset evening, C28 toon default / ?toon=off / default. C26 shadow tint stays enabled throughout. The 6 town camera poses are checked before and after measurement. Both other fixed-camera positions were checked against their C27 native reports.
